readiness.label: NPI is well formed and active in NPPES as the right type
Legal name matches the IRS name and the NPPES record
Taxonomy codes match the NPPES record
Practice locations are complete, with ZIP+4
Licenses, registrations and insurance stay current through the processing window
Supporting documents for this form are ready
The right person is set to sign
Revalidation is not past its due date

findings.message: A practice location must be a street address, not a P.O. box.
This item has already expired. Renew it before you submit.
Missing supporting document: IRS confirmation of the TIN and legal business name (for example CP-575) (Section 12 of the form).
The legal business name does not match the IRS name you gave. CMS requires the name reported to the IRS.
The legal business name does not match the organization name on the NPPES record for this NPI. The CMS-855B asks for the same legal business name and TIN used to get the NPI.
An organization's initial enrollment or revalidation must be signed by an authorized official. None is listed.
Use the 2-letter postal code for a US state or territory.
A taxonomy code is 10 characters: 9 letters or digits followed by X.
A ZIP code is 5 digits, or ZIP+4 as 12345-6789.
This item expires inside the processing window you set. Renew it now, or plan to report the renewal while the application is pending.
No telephone number for this location. The form asks for one if applicable.
Only 5 digits. The form asks for ZIP code + 4; look up the full ZIP+4 for this address.

notChecked: What the Medicare Administrative Contractor reviewer sees and decides, including site visits, background checks and fingerprinting.
Whether licenses, registrations and insurance are valid with the issuing board or carrier. Expiration dates are checked only as you entered them.
Ownership, managing employee and final adverse action details, and PECOS screens not covered by the input.
The CMS-855A, CMS-855R, CMS-855O and CMS-20134 forms.
Whether the documents you marked as ready are the right ones and are complete.
